theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → R.Represents S → ∃ (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (RQ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), RQ.Represents Q ∧ RQ.carrier = R.carrier ∩ W ∧ RQ.mult = R.mult ∧ RQ.orient = R.orient ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → Q (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω) = S ω) ∧ Q.support ⊆ closure W ∩ S.support ∧ IsCompact Q.support
